title: 第645章 爹爹是我不是你第644章 原始的索取
lines: 这日，从宫门到祭坛，石阶铺着朱红毡毯，甲卫林立，手持长戟，军容整肃。
祭天、礼乐齐鸣，文武百官伏在丹墀之下，三跪九叩，声震屋瓦。
陆铭章受了百官朝贺，没有立刻落座，而是侧过身，伸手牵出身后之人。
戴缨头戴珠冠，冠上九尾凤钗垂着细细的珠串，随着她的步伐轻轻晃动，她着一身深色朝服，裙裾曳地，大带、玉佩、绶环，样样周全，步步琳琅。
她的妆容极盛，眉描得远山一般长，唇间一点朱砂，衬出一国之母的端肃。
在礼官庄重而悠扬的腔音唱赞中，他执着她的手，一步一步走上高台。
这江山终是定下了，他和她对视一眼，之后的路还长，不论未来发生什么，他们彼此相伴。
陆铭章登极帝位，戴缨册立为后，海那边的罗扶和大燕俱遣使团前来道贺，献上国礼，各色贺礼堆满了偏殿，整整数日才登记完毕。
典礼是庄重的、盛大的，自然，也是累人的，作为典仪主人翁的戴缨也不例外。
那一整套朝服穿在身上，从清早到午后，几乎没有歇过一口气。
珠冠压得脖颈发酸，她端着仪态，端着微笑，端着一国之母该有的所有样子，就这么端了一整日。
是夜，她卸下了那一身沉重的礼服和冠冕，沐过身，穿着一件素色的寝衣，一头长发松松地披在身后，身上带着微微的潮气。
她坐在窗下的矮案边，手上擒着一个青瓷盏，慢饮，累了一天，好像连思考的力气都没有了，只想这么呆坐着。
宫婢带着女儿去了御园，不来闹她。
陆铭章着一身常服走了进来，手里拿着一个通体乌黑的木匣，他坐到她的对面，将木匣搁下，再推到她面前。
“这是什么？”她问。
“方才送到宫门外……”他给自己倒茶，声调平平，“弥国送来的。”
戴缨神情一凝，心里跟着一紧，搁于案上的手不自觉地蜷起。
陆铭章饮过茶水，放下杯，缓缓起身，待要往外去，她从后叫住他：“陛下去哪里？”
“这一日怪热的，身上出了汗，我去沐身更衣。”
戴缨垂下眼，低低应了一声。
陆铭章出了屋室，去沐间。
浴桶腾着热气，他靠坐浴桶内，两名宫婢侍于沐间，另有一人于他身后为他揉按肩颈。
他抬手往后招了招，那侍候的宫婢便退了出去。
弥国使臣前来，说是为庆贺乌滋帝后仪典，其皇帝陛下特意送上两份重礼。
一份是他刚才拿给戴缨的，一份是给他的。
阿伏干给他的那份礼，他看了，是一封书信，信中内容他已看过。
陆铭章亲启
见字如面，不，还是不必如面了，你我二人若再见面，只怕都不太体面。
有关战事，我没什么可说的，成王败寇，历来如此。
不过有一件事，我想了想，还是觉得该让你知道。
城中城，阿缨在簸箕巷的几年，过得什么样的日子，你可知？你不知，那么我来告诉你。
她住的是石砖小院，冬寒夏暑，她去井边打水，一双手冻得通红，裂了口子，拿针线的时候疼得龇牙。
她给孩子洗衣裳，舍不得用热水，冰水刺骨，她就那么搓，搓完在灶火边烤一烤，接着做下一件事。
她生阿婠的那个晚上，疼了一整夜，汗湿透了半张床褥，我在门外守着，她将所有的疼痛忍了下来，没有叫出声。
她真真实实过了几年民间日子，而这几年的市井生活，是我，是我陪在她的身边。
content_en:
On this day, the stone steps from the palace gate to the altar were covered with vermilion carpet, and there were many armored guards, holding halberds, and their military appearance was neat and tidy.
Sacrifices to the heavens, rituals and music were played in unison. Hundreds of civil and military officials fell under the Danqi, kneeling three times and knocking nine times, and the sound shook the tiles of the roof.
Lu Mingzhang received the congratulations from the officials and did not sit down immediately. Instead, he turned sideways and reached out to hold out the person behind him.
Dai Ying wears a beaded crown on her head, with a nine-tailed phoenix hairpin hanging with thin strings of beads, which sway gently with her steps. She is wearing a dark court dress, with a skirt that touches the floor, a large belt, a jade pendant, and a ribbon ring. Everything is thoughtful and elegant every step.
Her makeup was extremely rich, her eyebrows were as long as distant mountains, and a hint of cinnabar on her lips highlighted the solemnity of the mother of a country.
In the solemn and melodious singing of the official, he held her hand and walked up to the high platform step by step.
The world was finally settled. He and she looked at each other. There was still a long road ahead. No matter what happened in the future, they would be by each other's side.
When Lu Mingzhang ascended the throne and was enthroned by Dai Ying, Luo Fu and Dayan from across the sea sent envoys to congratulate him and offer them state gifts. All kinds of congratulatory gifts filled the side hall, and it took several days to complete the registration.
The ceremony is solemn, grand, and naturally tiring, and Dai Ying, as the master of the ceremony, is no exception.
Wearing that whole set of court clothes, from early morning to afternoon, I barely took a breath.
The beaded crown made her neck ache from the pressure. She kept her manners, her smile, everything that a mother of a country should look like, and she stayed like this all day long.
That night, she took off her heavy dress and crown, took a bath, and wore a plain nightgown. Her long hair was hung loosely behind her, and her body was slightly moist.
She sat at the low table under the window, holding a celadon cup in her hand, drinking slowly. After a long day of exhaustion, she seemed to have no energy to think, and just wanted to sit like this.
The maid took her daughter to the imperial garden and did not bother her.
Lu Mingzhang walked in wearing regular clothes, holding a black wooden box in his hand. He sat opposite her, put the wooden box down, and pushed it in front of her.
"What is this?" she asked.
"I just sent it outside the palace gate..." He poured himself tea and said in a calm voice, "It was sent by Miguo."
Dai Ying's expression condensed, her heart tightened, and her hand on the case curled up unconsciously.
Lu Mingzhang drank the tea, put down the cup, and stood up slowly. When he was about to go out, she called him from behind: "Where are you going, Your Majesty?"
"It's a very hot day and I'm sweating. I'm going to take a shower and change clothes."
Dai Ying lowered her eyes and responded in a low voice.
Lu Mingzhang left the room and went to the bathroom.
The bathtub was steaming, and he sat in the bathtub. Two palace maids were waiting in the bathtub, and another person was behind him, massaging his shoulders and neck.
He raised his hand and waved back, and the maid in attendance withdrew.
An envoy from the Mi Kingdom came and said that it was to celebrate the ceremony of Empress Wuzi, and that His Majesty the Emperor specially sent two heavy gifts.
One was what he had just given to Dai Ying, and the other was for him.
He read the gift Avgan gave him. It was a letter, and he had already read the content of the letter.
Lu Mingzhang in person
We are like faces when we see each other, no, there is no need to be like faces anymore. If you and I meet again, I'm afraid it won't be very honorable.
I have nothing to say about war. The winner is the king and the loser is the enemy. This has always been the case.
But there is one thing, after thinking about it, I still think I should let you know.
In a city within a city, do you know what kind of life A Ying lived in Dustpan Alley for several years? If you don’t know, let me tell you.
She lived in a small stone-brick courtyard. It was cold in winter and hot in summer. When she went to the well to fetch water, her hands were red and cracked from the cold, and she grimaced in pain when holding needle and thread.
She washed her children's clothes and was reluctant to use hot water. The ice water was biting to the bone, so she just rubbed them. After rubbing, she roasted them by the stove before doing the next thing.
The night she gave birth to Ah Hu, she was in pain all night long, and half of the mattress was soaked with sweat. I stood guard outside the door, and she endured all the pain without screaming.
She really lived a private life for several years, and in these few years of urban life, I was by her side.
